articles.headline: No. 25 Nebraska women cruise past North Carolina A&T 76-35
articles.description: — Britt Prince made four 3-pointers and finished with 24 points to lead No. 25 Nebraska to a 76-35 victory over North Carolina A&T on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: No. 9 LSU routs McNeese 100-43 for its third straight blowout win
